window.description: A half-open window kept in whole milliseconds; finer digits are dropped. A window longer than the max_time_window of a historical source is counted in parts of at most max_time_window; only a window that needs more than 24 parts is clipped to its newest parts, which the source report states.

until.description: Exclusive upper bound; not in the future.

window.title: SupportOperationsWindow

code.description: Stable reason code of a non-ok status.

items.description: A half-open window kept in whole milliseconds; finer digits are dropped. A window longer than the max_time_window of a historical source is counted in parts of at most max_time_window; only a window that needs more than 24 parts is clipped to its newest parts, which the source report states.

until.description: Exclusive upper bound; not in the future.

items.title: SupportOperationsWindow

buckets.description: At most 12 buckets that tile the window exactly and end at its end; a line counts in the bucket whose half-open span holds its time. Only the first bucket may be shorter than bucket_seconds.

bucket_seconds.description: Width of every bucket but the first.

id.description: Position in the whole answer (L1 is the most frequent group).

message.description: The exact logged message; untrusted data.

secrets_redacted.description: Authentication secrets inside the message were replaced.

message_exact.description: message is the stored text unchanged and works as the message filter of operational_log_events; false when a secret was replaced or a format character made visible. Then filter the events by instance and the group's buckets instead.

status.description: A counted message is an observation, never an incident.

symptom.description: Diagnostics symptom code of a profiled message.

counts.description: One count per entry of buckets.

page.description: The page of the message groups; total counts every group of the answer.
